#!/bin/sh
set -eu
output=
previous=
shared=false
for arg do
    if [ "$previous" = -o ]; then output="$arg"; fi
    case "$arg" in
        --shared|-shared) shared=true ;;
        */libgetrandom-*.rlib)
            name=${arg##*/}
            dep="${arg%/*}/${name#lib}"
            if grep -q '/getrandom-0\.3\.3/src/' "${dep%.rlib}.d"; then
                getrandom="$arg"
            fi
            ;;
    esac
    previous="$arg"
done
case "$output" in
    */librustc_driver*.so)
        if "$shared"; then
            : "${getrandom:?rustc_driver must link getrandom 0.3.3}"
            "$X2_RUSTC" --edition=2021 --crate-type=lib --emit=obj -Dwarnings -Copt-level=2 \
                -Crelocation-model=pic --target "$RUST_TARGET_PATH/x86_64-breenix-hosted.json" \
                -L "all=$X2_SYSROOT_DEPS" -L "dependency=${getrandom%/*}" \
                --extern "getrandom=$getrandom" "$RUST_TARGET_PATH/toolchain/rust-host/k5/getrandom.rs" \
                -o "$X2_CONFIG_ROOT/getrandom.o"
            set -- "$@" "$X2_CONFIG_ROOT/getrandom.o" "$X2_CONFIG_ROOT/dynamic-libs/libblake3_sse2_sse41_avx2_assembly.a"
        fi
        ;;
esac

archive_preparation.procedure: A link-local copy of PIC libc localizes the two static unwind stubs and moves the CRT pointer table and the hidden self-relative __dso_handle to .data.rel.ro with LLVM objcopy. The bunwind link archive retains its own and core objects, localizes its panic handler and uses the hosted sysroot compiler builtins.

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true
export CARGO_HOME="$X/cargo"
cd "$REPO/libs/libbreenix-libc"
for target in x86_64-breenix-c aarch64-breenix; do
    printf 'Building hosted rustc PIC libc for %s\n' "$target"
    RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings -C relocation-model=pic' cargo build --release --offline --locked \
        --features hosted-rustc -Z build-std=core,compiler_builtins \
        -Z build-std-features=compiler-builtins-mem --target "$REPO/$target.json" \
        --target-dir "$X/r105/runtime"
done

preparation_wrapper.text:
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

raw, archive = map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
llvm = Path('/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm@20/bin')
operations = {
    '_Unwind_Backtrace': ['--localize-symbol=_Unwind_Backtrace'],
    '_Unwind_GetIP': ['--localize-symbol=_Unwind_GetIP'],
    '__breenix_array_bounds': ['--rename-section',
        '.rodata.breenix_array_bounds=.data.rel.ro.breenix_array_bounds,alloc,load,data,contents'],
    '__dso_handle': ['--rename-section',
        '.rodata.breenix_dso_handle=.data.rel.ro.breenix_dso_handle,alloc,load,data,contents'],
}
members = defaultdict(list)
listing = subprocess.check_output([llvm/'llvm-nm','--print-file-name','--defined-only','-g',raw],
                                  text=True,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
for symbol,args in operations.items():
    matches = re.findall(r'(?m)^.+?:([^:\n]+): [0-9a-f]+ [A-Z] '+re.escape(symbol)+r'$',listing)
    assert len(matches) == 1,(symbol,matches)
    members[matches[0]].extend(args)
shutil.copyfile(raw,archive)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='libc-relro-',dir=archive.parent) as temp:
    root=Path(temp)
    for member,args in members.items():
        original = root / 'before.o'
        with original.open('wb') as dest:
            subprocess.run([llvm/'llvm-ar','p',raw,member],stdout=dest,check=True)
        subprocess.run([llvm/'llvm-objcopy',*args,original,root/member],check=True)
        subprocess.run([llvm/'llvm-ar','rcs',archive,root/member],check=True)
        print(member,*args)

libc_layout_controls.decision: Build getentropy into the hosted-rustc libc archive for X2. The two true_test controls pass ruling 98 with only permitted non-loadable symbol metadata differences.

hosted_loadable_differences.x86_64_cause: The hosted target dynamic-linking field changes crate hashes and text placement. Each changed ELF matches the ruling 104(3) target-field-only candidate under the ruling 98 comparator.

kd_proposal.scope: Both kernel ELF loaders. The measured x86-64 rustc is ET_EXEC with PT_INTERP /lib/ld-breenix.so. Map an ET_DYN interpreter at its own bias, build the ELF auxiliary vector from plan 5.4 and transfer to the interpreter. Check the missing-interpreter rollback before guest acceptance.

kd_proposal.unit: Rust loader mapping, symbol lookup and relocations
